# Nadlanzebait (נדל״ן זה בית)

> Arik Naim is a real-estate agent working Tel Aviv, Israel: honest
> valuations, on-site property listings with full detail (no external
> marketplace links), customer testimonials, and a WhatsApp-first way to
> reach him. 12 years working the same neighborhoods, 400+ apartments sold,
> average 28 days to sale, 98% of asking price.

The site is available in English (US), English (UK), Hebrew, French,
Russian, and Spanish, and is mobile-first.

## Pages

- [Home](https://morkatzwonder.github.io/Nadlanzebait/): overview, current
  property listings, client testimonials, and a contact / free-valuation
  form.
